scope: Proposition 2.5 (Regulator input) of the manuscript “Critical Center Magnetization in the Planar XY Model” (preprints/Critical-Center-Magnetization-in-the-Planar-XY-Model-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 216 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8347485745eaf583), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The regulator in (2.10) is finite, nonnegative, homogeneous quadratic, and constant invariant. It is monotone under support enlargement and additive on compatible separated supports, and 0 ≤ Vj(X, ψ) ≤ CED(Bsαψ) ≤ C⟨ψ, ADψ⟩. The shell and terminal regulator estimates of [Ope26a, Lemmas 4.4 and 9.2] hold with Wκ u replaced by Wκ u eVj , at a cost C|X|. For a small connected input the output retains the half-exponent reserve W κ/2 Lu ; the coefficient of the observation regulator is unchanged. The localizations and analytic partition map retain their contraction and nonlinear estimates in (2.11).
